macos.rationale: Desktop builds for macOS, Windows and Linux are listed, with winget, Homebrew, .deb, Arch (yay) and Nix install routes. The install guide says Intel Macs get the desktop app but no t3 executable. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

web-client.rationale: Running t3 opens a local web app; app.t3.codes is a hosted client that needs an HTTPS endpoint the user operates. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

ios.rationale: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play) apps are linked; they connect to a server on another machine. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

android.rationale: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play) apps are linked; they connect to a server on another machine. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

cli.rationale: t3 CLI starts the server and provides service, update, pair and connect commands; the install doc says there is no t3 executable for Intel Macs, where only the desktop app is offered. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

claude-code.rationale: v0.1.7 documents installed Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity, Pi, Muse Code and fx providers. Model availability follows provider accounts; mixed-provider execution was not tested. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

antigravity.rationale: T3 Code v0.1.8 runs Google's official Antigravity ACP agent on the selected environment with managed runtime installation and its own sign-in. The ACP agent has a separate sign-in from the IDE or CLI. Runtime installation supports Apple Silicon macOS, Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64/ARM64; Intel Macs need a supported remote environment.

byo-subscription.rationale: Works with the user's existing subscriptions through the provider CLIs; Codex can connect with a ChatGPT plan. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

local.rationale: The desktop app or t3 runs a local server and agents. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:RUN-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

own-server.rationale: Desktop-managed SSH starts or reuses a server on a Linux or Apple Silicon host; projects, credentials and agent work stay there. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:RUN-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

worktree.rationale: New worktree gives a thread its own branch and working directory; optional storage cleanup policies (off by default) can remove managed worktrees. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:RUN-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

parallel-runs.rationale: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter starts a thread in the background and opens another draft; each submission can create its own worktree. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code web client, T3 Code mobile.

pr-workflow.rationale: Create, link, review, check out, merge and auto-merge pull requests across GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo/Gitea, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps (feature set varies by host); auto-merge is documented only for GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:SHIP-03; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

review-ui.rationale: The stable source-control guide documents changed-file, branch and commit diffs and a PR review interface. Review guides are optional beta; no usability fixture is claimed. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:SHIP-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

license.rationale: MIT License covers the repository including desktop, mobile and web clients. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

self-hosting.rationale: The server runs directly (t3 serve) with LAN, tailnet or SSH access. Scope: T3 Code server and CLI, T3 Code desktop. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:OWN-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false disables product events. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:OWN-03; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

free-tier.rationale: No T3 Tools subscription fee is currently charged. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

starting-price.rationale: No T3 Tools subscription fee is currently charged. Scope: T3 Code desktop, T3 Code mobile, T3 Code web client, T3 Code server and CLI.

coordinator.rationale: Stable app-owned MCP delegation controls child threads across compatible providers with durable task results; distinct from a harness-only subagent feature. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:COORD-03; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Server-owned one-time/recurring/webhook tasks run without an active client turn; the host must remain running. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:COORD-04; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

multiplayer.rationale: Optional beta guest links let another human submit text/files to the same agent work; each prompt requires the owner Send approval. This is moderated prompting. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:TEAM-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

laptop-independent.rationale: Agents can run on a user-owned remote server or VPS, reached through T3 Connect, SSH or private pairing. The separate host must stay running and reachable while the laptop client disconnects. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to t3-code:RUN-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

no-paid-plan.rationale: Terms state no T3 Tools subscription fee currently.
